hero.title: You have a need.
hero.subtitle: Before writing a single line of code, we understand your operation, your timeline and what you actually need. Then we build.
hero.prop1Desc: We don't arrive with a predefined solution. We understand your business before proposing anything.
hero.prop2Desc: Every project is unique. No templates, no features you won't use, no artificial limitations.
hero.prop3Desc: We don't disappear after delivery. We stay with you through launch and beyond.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Two engineers focused on understanding before building.
services.ctaBannerDesc: If your need doesn't fit any category, reach out anyway. We can probably help.

web.title: Web Development
web.problem: Does your business lack a digital presence, or is it not generating results?
web.desc: Modern, fast and optimized websites and web apps. From a landing page to complex platforms with an admin panel.

software.title: Custom Software
software.problem: Are you using Excel or WhatsApp to manage your operation?
software.desc: Systems designed exactly for your workflow. No paying for features you don't use and no adapting to what a template allows.

automation.title: Automations
automation.problem: Is your team losing hours on repetitive tasks that could run themselves?
automation.desc: We connect your tools, eliminate manual processes and free your team's time for what actually matters.
automation.feature3: Measurable time savings from day one

consulting.title: Tech Consulting
consulting.problem: Do you know you need technology but don't know where to start?
consulting.desc: We help you understand your options, choose the right tools and chart a clear path before investing in development.

process.title:
We understand first,
then we build.
process.subtitle: Every project follows a clear process. No surprises, no improvisation.

discover.title: Discovery
discover.desc: We listen. We understand your business, your operation and what you actually need to solve before talking technology.

plan.title: Proposal
plan.desc: We present a clear plan: what will be built, how and on what timeline. No fine print, no vague commitments.

build.title: Development
build.desc: We build with attention to detail. We keep you informed at every stage so there are never surprises at the end.

deliver.title: Delivery & support
deliver.desc: We deliver, train and stay alongside you. We don't disappear when the project is done.

process.noteDesc: We don't work with invented deadlines just to close a deal. Every estimate is based on the real scope of your need.

about.title:
We understand your business.
Then we build.
about.subtitle: We don't arrive with a predefined solution. We get involved in your processes.
about.body: JCF Tech was born from a simple conviction: businesses don't need generic technology, they need solutions that reflect how they operate, how they think and what they want to project.
about.body2: Before proposing anything, we understand your business. Your processes, your team, your customer. Only then do we build — whether it's a custom system, a web platform or an automation — made for you, not adapted from a template.
about.caligaDesc: We are also the creators of CALIGA, an aeronautical management SaaS platform with full traceability for aviation operators in Latin America.
